crossRefs.note: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully…
but in everything commending ourselves, as servants of God, in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in…
For if he who comes preaches another Jesus, whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit, which you…
But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you…
For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me, for the obedience of the…
in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to…
that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge;
If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

translations.web: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.
translations.bsb: The marks of a true apostle—signs, wonders, and miracles—were performed among you with great perseverance.
translations.kjv: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
translations.asv: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, by signs and wonders and mighty works.
